description: This Java source file defines a factory class 'PolicyOrAclEnforcerRetrieverFactory' which creates instances of 'EnforcerRetriever'. It manages enforcer retrieval by choosing between policy and ACL enforcer caches based on resource types for enforcement logic in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: PolicyOrAclEnforcerRetrieverFactory
classes.description: A final utility class that provides a static method to create 'EnforcerRetriever' instances, choosing caches based on resource types.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an 'EnforcerRetriever' instance that retrieves enforcers from specified caches depending on whether the resource type is a policy or an ACL. It sets up a mapping between resource types and caches.
